reason: Conversation 1 gives a coherent diagnosis (door interlock switch or latch/door sag, with control fault less likely), safe homeowner checks (clean the latch, test the door play, close the door firmly as a workaround), and clearly escalates to an engineer without recommending a DIY teardown. It does overstate certainty with 'pretty much settle it' and adds a minor warranty note, but it remains within the acceptable directions. Conversation 2 is fragmented and templated, wrongly introduces a blown fuse, asks irrelevant questions (a socket check, a release button feel, 'plug it back in', a door-opening difficulty question), and ends with a non-answer. It does eventually point to an engineer, but less clearly and with little useful guidance.
